name: KIC 11026472
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 8.0 solar radii and 1.75 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11026472 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 8.0309 +/- 0.1389

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11026472 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.7503 +/- 0.0672

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11026472 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4817.2974 +/- 44.9582

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11026472 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.8734 +/- 0.0039

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.75 solar masses and 8.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,817 K at its surface.
